name: agency
description: The sense that your actions or decisions are your own and they're important.

variations.name: responsible agency
variations.description: The sense that you are willing and able to perform tasks expected of you.

variations.name: insubordination
variations.description: Making your own decision in conflict to a request or demand from an important person in the social group. This may come with consequence or a loss of status with that group.

variations.name: ambitious agency
variations.description: The sense that you can improve the situation beyond what is expected of you.

variations.name: controlling agency
variations.description: A feeling that you are needed to guide or correct the actions of others whether they agree with you or not.

variations.name: existential agency
variations.description: A sense that your actions are aligned with a deep sense of purpose.

commentaries.quote: Cultures have different views on the balance between personal agency and being part of the group, but most people have a desire to make some of their own decisions.
Many people over-emphasize the importance of their control, and many more under-emphasize it. There's no right balance that's going to work in all situations.
Civilization works only because we humans can operate independently or let go of some self-interest in order to work together in groups.

conditions: A perception that your actions or decisions are your own and they're important.
